crossRefs.note: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak.…
“Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of…
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord…
Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.
“Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am…
The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.

translations.web: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea, have replenished.
translations.bsb: Be silent, O dwellers of the coastland, you merchants of Sidon, whose traders have crossed the sea.
translations.kjv: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
translations.asv: Be still, ye inhabitants of the coast, thou whom the merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
